description: The manifest project rows that lack an MCP tool or a CLI command. The per-command decisions (which MCP tools and CLI commands perform each document command the GUI sends, or the gap that says why one is missing) live on each CommandSpec in src/podcast_mcp/services/document_sync/registry.py. scripts/check_capabilities_manifest.py fails when a command type has no registry entry, when the GUI sends a type its entry does not name, when a name does not resolve, and when a gap is stale, so gaps only shrink. Add an edit: see docs/entry-points.md item 4. Known gap outside the table: the pipeline step extract_room_tone_beds (room_tone.extract_bed) and RoomToneBedService give a track a room-tone bed with no document command, MCP tool, CLI command or GUI action of their own, so a bed cannot yet be extracted or cleared one track at a time; the next slice adds that command and its inverse.
